perplayerquests.server_global.quest.tool: Progress is shared across the ENTIRE server. Every player on every team contributes to the same progress; when it completes, it completes for everyone.
perplayerquests.per_player.quest.tooltip: When enabled, this quest's completion is tracked separately for each player instead of shared across the team.
perplayerquests.per_player.collapse.tool: When a team-scoped quest depends on this per-player quest: ALL = met only when every member completes it; ANY = met when any member does.
perplayerquests.per_player.show_roster_t: When enabled, hovering this quest shows every team member's individual completion status.
perplayerquests.per_player.exclusivity_s: Only matters for two FTB mechanics, set on different quests: (1) Branch choice - set this on the SHARED PREREQUISITE quest that has Max Completable Dependents. TEAM = one player picking a branch locks it out for the whole team; PER_ACTOR = each player picks their own branch independently. (2) N-of-M threshold - set this on the quest that HAS Min Required Dependencies. TEAM = counts completions across the whole team; PER_ACTOR = counts only that player's own completions. No effect on a quest using neither mechanic.
perplayerquests.per_player.task.tooltip: When enabled, this task's progress is tracked separately for each player instead of shared across the team.
perplayerquests.per_player.task_mode.too: INHERIT: follow the parent quest. FORCE_ON: always per-player. FORCE_OFF: always team-shared (a shared sub-goal inside a per-player quest).
perplayerquests.per_player.picker.title: Per-Player: %s
perplayerquests.per_player.picker.type_n: Type a player name, press Enter to reset
perplayerquests.unique.global.tooltip: Only ONE player on the entire server may ever hold this quest. Once claimed it locks for everyone else, across all teams.
NAME shows who claimed it to other players; ANONYMOUS shows a generic placeholder instead of their name.
perplayerquests.unique.inherit.tooltip: FROM_DEPENDENCY: this quest is locked to whoever claimed the UNIQUE quest it depends on, instead of having its own claim. NONE: unaffected by dependencies.
perplayerquests.unique.unclaimed_on_star: ★ Unique — first to start a task claims it
perplayerquests.unique.unclaimed_on_comp: ★ Unique — first to complete this quest claims it
